title: utPLSQL Announcements
description: Releases and news from the utPLSQL project

items.title: Next chapter for utPLSQL
items.content_html: utPLSQL v3 has come a long way since it was first released in 2017. It has already been over 10 years since the first discussions about starting the project began. However…

items.title: Incorporation of utPLSQL Development Labs Ltd
items.content_html: For many years, utPLSQL has been built and maintained through the contributions of dedicated and passionate engineers from the community.

items.title: utPLSQL-cli and utPLSQL-maven-plugin v3.2.1 released
items.content_html: Both utPLSQL-cli and utPLSQL-maven-plugin v3.2.1 are now available, adding support for Oracle Wallet (Secure External Password Store) connections.

items.title: Welcome to new web site
items.content_html: Welcome to the new utPLSQL website. We are still in the early stages of moving to GitHub.

items.title: Documentation is now hosted.
items.content_html: Issue #19 to link documentation to the website has been completed.

items.title: utPLSQL v3.0.3 - released
items.content_html: Added ability to exclude columns/attributes for cursor/object/collection comparison. Xpath can be used for column/attribute exclusion · +23 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.0.4 - released
items.content_html: Removed overloaded procedures ut_runner.run · utPLSQL will not not open new transaction when running tests · Added buffering of dbms_output before the run · +8 more

items.title: We've released utPLSQL-cli
items.content_html: You may find the client on the download page

items.title: utPLSQL-cli v3.1.0 released
items.content_html: Java8 · Oracle JDBC driver file (ojdbc8.jar) is required · Oracle i18n driver file (orai18n.jar) is required for national character-set support · +6 more

items.title: Better late than never
items.content_html: On April 25th, a major release 3.1.0 of utPLSQL was published on github and the information was not published on our site.

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.2 released
items.content_html: Added ability to join and compare cursor content by specific columns (PK/UK) · Added support for comma separated list of suite paths/packages when calling ut.run · +23 more

items.title: utPLSQL-cli v3.1.2 released
items.content_html: This version of utPLQL-cli is compatible with all versions of utPLSQL from 3.0.0 to 3.1.3. We encourage you to always use the latest version of cli to communicate with a v3 core.
